system.description: A compact shovel with additional screw-on head attachments and tools stored in the shaft. It includes a hammer, prybar, saw, screwdriver, wirecutters, and wrench. While a multi-tool can’t replace a proper engineering or fabrication kit, it can be used to build a variety of simple structures (defensive firing points, latrines, etc.) or to facilitate basic maintenance when the proper tools aren’t available. At the GM’s discretion, a multi-tool can be used in place of an engineering kit to make repairs during a long rest, but repairing only 1d6 damage.
